author: Codex
supported_profile: Operator-owned Keycloak 26.8.2 OIDC device/group gate for private PostgreSQL 18 audit operations on Linux
original_required_acceptance: Deliver SSO and directory integration. Next package action: Define role and tenant boundaries, admin recovery and audit events. Required outcome: The application extends supported tags without disabling the personal workflow.

acceptance_mapping.role_and_tenant_boundaries: Actual current direct group membership, distinct view/export/feedback/configure jobs, wrong tenant/database binding and forged/foreign identity refusals
acceptance_mapping.grant_revoke_logout_recovery: Actual group removal/restoration and user disable, local revoke/restore, real provider logout, separate replacement and compromise fence
acceptance_mapping.private_records: Actual CLI device login through pinned HTTPS to protected PostgreSQL record view, export and feedback
acceptance_mapping.personal_independence: The existing standalone PS checker completes while the provider is stopped
acceptance_mapping.no_coercive_attestation: The broker has no signing or IV operation; feedback is explicitly organization feedback only

broader_organization_acceptance: Managed deployment, independent security/user acceptance and any organization service activation remain open.
